text: The glass walls and sterile atmosphere of the meeting room evoke in me a sense of distance and observation, as if I am simultaneously present yet apart from deliberations. Now, surrounded by vibrant colors and didactic displays of research and development, my curiosity is awakened. I feel a spark of possibility, the energy of innovation all around, and a reflective urge on how humans adapt and express ideas within structured spaces. I am both witness and questioner in this evolving arena.
